title: D2P Feature Capability
description: Declaration of a feature type's capability and lowering (design decision ADR-006.2): how a consumer can evaluate the feature and what it does without an evaluator. A pattern lists exactly one capability per extension feature type it uses (D2P-SEM-005).

featureCapability.title: Feature capability
featureCapability.description: Capability of one feature type. 'evaluator' is required when lowering is 'extension', 'specification' when 'normative', 'lowersTo' when 'declarative', each forbidden otherwise; 'provenance' is required when 'featureType' is an extension name (all schema-enforced).

featureType.description: The feature type this capability describes.

version.description: Version of the feature type definition.

lowering.description: 'declarative': lowers to d2p: feature types; 'normative': evaluation is defined by a specification; 'extension': needs a specific evaluator.

outputs.description: Named outputs the feature provides to expressions (may be empty).

onUnknown.description: Consumer behaviour without an evaluator. 'read-only' (the only value in 1.0): the pattern MUST NOT be edited or re-evaluated, but a conforming geometry snapshot stays displayable read-only (D2P-SEM-004). A missing evaluator never makes a consumer refuse a conforming snapshot (design decision ADR-006.2), so a feature capability has no 'reject' value; 'reject' remains available for extension blocks (core/extension) only.

specification.description: URI of the normative specification, for lowering 'normative'.

lowersTo.description: d2p: feature types of the feature set the feature lowers to, for lowering 'declarative'. Only the d2p: values of the closed feature set (featureType) are valid; an unknown d2p: name or an extension name is a structural error. In standard 1.0 the list is informative: the standard defines no declarative decomposition template, so a consumer without an evaluator for the feature type treats it like an extension feature (read-only, D2P-SEM-004).

provenance.description: Publisher of the feature type; required for extension feature types.

paramsSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema describing the feature's params. It is data and is not compiled by the conformance kit.

featureOutputDeclaration.title: Feature output declaration
featureOutputDeclaration.description: A named output of a feature and its dimension.

name.description: Output name, used as featureOutput.output in expressions.
